approval.by: carried over from the copied-in Forge

outcome: Scheduled jobs now ask for permission the same way a chat does: when a job needs a tool it is not yet allowed to use, one living card appears in the job's chat with Allow/Deny buttons and no timer, the run waits in place, and an Allow-always answer is remembered for future runs. The job notification was rebuilt alongside it: exactly one message per run, edited from Running into the result, rendered natively on Telegram, Slack and Discord, leading with a one-line outcome, then the per-tool results, then the next run time. Operators also got a heredoc-aware command gate, honest 'this request stays open' wording on job prompts, and the KnackLabs incident class (one card edited ten thousand times) is closed by JSONB-faithful settlement.
title: Chat-parity permissions for scheduled jobs
